nodes.title: Orient, detect actual tools and permissions, recover evidence, ask only material missing facts
nodes.notes: Minimal social prompt starts this task. Ask scoped private-mail permission only if absent; opening the URL does not grant it. Manual redacted correspondence is an equal supported path.

nodes.title: Verify election, mission, stage, competent authority, contacts and office hours
nodes.notes: Resolve critical uncertainty before legal filing. Public contact seeds are not authoritative case-specific routing.

nodes.question: Has a decision been received?
evidence_required: decision document or accurate user-provided description

nodes.question: What stage and outcome does the received document actually establish?
evidence_required: Full operative content, issuer and stage; do not classify a title alone

nodes.title: Save decision and check the specific polling-place arrangements

nodes.question: Does the competent administration confirm it has the case?

nodes.title: Request the missing decision and delivery information
nodes.notes: Identify the specific missing decision; acknowledgement, recording and preliminary positive outcomes are not adverse. T16 obtains the full document and delivery evidence.

nodes.title: Trace original receipt/forwarding through mission and MFA
nodes.notes: Confirmed administration non-receipt calls for original mission trace; MFA escalation is selected at FOLLOWUP.02, not automatic.

nodes.title: Trace status on both consular and register sides
nodes.notes: Unknown status requires both relevant traces; it does not establish non-receipt or a legal violation. Escalate proportionately after assessing evidence and urgency.

nodes.title: Create written follow-ups and local-time calling plan
nodes.notes: Select T03 only for an actual call, T04 only for actual failed attempts, T07 only for a justified reminder. CALL.01 requires a valid return_to. Re-entry on a new reply is recorded at a wait node.

nodes.question: Is the adverse decision a municipal/city-administration decision?
Is the adverse decision issued by MDULS?

nodes.title: Verify admissibility, receipt time, deadline, addressee and valid channel; prepare appeal
nodes.notes: Published MDULS baseline is 24 hours from receipt; apply only after verifying current rules and the actual decision.

nodes.title: Obtain urgent legal assessment and preparation of the appropriate court action
nodes.notes: Verify court requirements separately; do not reuse an administrative email-filing assumption.

nodes.question: Is failure to issue the specific required decision legally established as overdue?

nodes.title: Verify admissibility and prepare first-instance silence appeal if applicable
nodes.notes: First-instance only; verify admissibility, competent authority, receipt, specific overdue decision and applicable deadline. Never reuse for second-instance silence after appeal.

nodes.title: Ask for explicit procedural guidance and urgent legal assistance
nodes.notes: Ask T08/T14 only for actual unresolved procedural/legal facts. Do not await replies if a deadline may run. Preserve outstanding facts and next external action; no repeat loop on unchanged evidence.

nodes.title: Independently assess documented handling irregularities by each authority
nodes.notes: Select T09/T10 only for documented possible handling irregularities and the correct authority, or select none. Complaints never replace or pause a remedy. Independent remedy lane may continue.

nodes.question: Has an appropriate complaint been selected?

nodes.title: Preserve evidence and record concrete next check/action; await a new event
nodes.notes: Choose a case-specific check time and human owner. Any running legal deadline proceeds independently. A reminder plan is not configured monitoring.

resume_on.event: New status reply or decision received
Verified new deadline evidence for the missing decision
Scheduled user return with updated facts

nodes.title: Complete and sign the appropriate submission and evidence list
nodes.notes: A complete signed filing is distinct from saved draft or sent mail. No unresolved critical placeholders; minimise evidence disclosure to each recipient.

nodes.question: Is the applicable electronic submission channel and required form confirmed?

nodes.title: Ask receiving registry for channel/signature/receipt requirements
nodes.notes: For a short deadline, arrange the backup in parallel, not after waiting for a reply.

nodes.title: Seek verified representative and lawful timely backup, subject to explicit approval
nodes.notes: Verify authorisation, document form, actual receiving authority, timing and user-approved engagement. Seeking help does not establish available filing.

nodes.title: Submit through confirmed valid electronic route, within authorised scope
nodes.notes: Reconfirm user approval for this exact signed document, recipients/channel and actual attachments before execution. Email sending alone is not legal filing validity.

nodes.question: Is there reliable evidence of a valid timely submission?

nodes.title: Check registration and correct/complete filing through a verified lawful backup
nodes.notes: One bounded registration/channel check and applicable correction attempt; no repeated filing without checking prior submission. Missing acknowledgement does not itself prove non-receipt or invalidity.

nodes.title: Save timestamp, valid filing evidence and case number; identify next external check
nodes.notes: Keep appeal history and stage. Second-instance silence uses SILENCE.SECOND, never a repeated first-instance appeal.

nodes.title: Record call outcome in the authority thread and return to explicit caller ID
nodes.notes: Parameterized subroutine; return_to is mandatory and must exist. Answered -> T03; unanswered -> T04. Record actual attempts only. Return to caller once, not an unlimited retry loop.

nodes.title: Save acknowledgement/recording/preliminary positive evidence and identify the still-missing decision
nodes.notes: Never route this outcome as adverse or assume final polling-place approval.

nodes.question: Is further trace escalation justified by the missing evidence, prior response and urgency?
evidence_required: Current trace gap and actual contacts/outcomes; verified relevant authority

nodes.title: Select proportionate mission/MFA or register/MDULS trace escalation
nodes.notes: Choose only the relevant lane(s), verified recipients and necessary evidence; do not assert non-receipt unless confirmed. Approval before sending.

nodes.question: Which authority and procedural stage has the verified overdue decision?
evidence_required: Issuer/competence, specific pending decision, appeal history and filing proof

nodes.title: Obtain separate urgent assessment of litigation/other remedy for second-instance silence
nodes.notes: Verify conditions of administrative litigation or other applicable remedy separately. T11 is not this remedy. No automatic court action.

nodes.question: Is this specific submission legally/procedurally ready and expressly authorised?
evidence_required: Applicable conditions and deadline verified; no critical unresolved legal facts
Explicit approval for filing/complaint and any representation; URL or read permission is insufficient

nodes.question: Is a timely lawful backup actually available and authorised?
evidence_required: Confirmed representative availability, proper authorisation/form, competent recipient/channel, timing and user approval

nodes.title: Perform the specifically approved lawful backup and obtain actual filing evidence
nodes.notes: Do not claim representative filing until confirmed. Agree immediate delivery of filing proof and any received decision with exact timestamps.

nodes.title: Record the exact missing trace fact, next source/contact and bounded next check
nodes.notes: Finish reachable evidence work; preserve a possible legal deadline independently. No repeated unchanged trace loop.

resume_on.event: New reply/document resolves the trace gap
User returns after the recorded check with actual outcomes

nodes.title: Name missing legal/filing conditions and request specific guidance or urgent legal help
nodes.notes: Give a concrete source/contact/action and check time. Mark inability to guarantee a filing/deadline if critical facts remain unknown; do not wait past a running deadline.

resume_on.event: New document or procedural advice supplies missing conditions
Specific submission becomes verified and ready

nodes.title: Present exact proposed document, recipients/channel and available attachments for approval
nodes.notes: No send, filing or representation before corresponding approval. Refusal ends that action; continue manual assistance if desired.

resume_on.event: User grants approval for the specific complete action

nodes.title: State unavailable lawful timely route and seek urgent real legal assistance
nodes.notes: Do not guarantee timely filing, use ordinary mail as a fake fallback, or repeatedly retry without a changed route. Record reachable contact/action and deadline risk.

resume_on.event: A new lawful available route and conditions are confirmed

nodes.title: Preserve attempted filing and bounded check outcome; await evidence or a verified correction route
nodes.notes: Report sent, received, registered and validly filed distinctly. Set a specific next action/check; short deadlines require urgent parallel backup, not passive monitoring.

resume_on.event: New verified lawful correction or backup is available

concurrent_lanes: evidence tracing without delaying a running deadline
unknown_policy: Unknown evidence/legal facts stay unknown. Wait nodes preserve specific external re-entry intent; no internal retry loop manufactures progress.
source_scope: Adapted from original 0.1 procedure; stable IDs retained where possible. Not an active election calendar or autonomous filing authorisation.

execution_policy.external_actions: Explicit scoped approval before sends, filings or representation. Draft permission is separate. Verify actual attachment availability.
execution_policy.reentry: Wait nodes end the current pass. resume_on edges are taken only on a new stated event or user return, never internal polling.
execution_policy.duplicate_prevention: Review authorised existing threads, sent follow-ups and drafts before creating or sending another.
execution_policy.monitoring: No background monitoring unless supported, approved and actually configured.
execution_policy.calls: Bounded attempts in verified office hours; never delay written follow-up or a possible legal deadline.
